new: The robot gang is the first of the app's stories moved into a story package (packages/robots/): the same story, the same place on the Stories screen and the same #robots link.
Take all stories (the Stories screen): every story, its models and its narration on this device for use offline, in the background, with progress. An installed app takes them by itself.
The Stories screen's order comes from one list (packages/order.json), whether a story has moved into a package or not.
test: Open the robot gang from the Stories screen and in a headset: it should play with its narration, and its station in a shared room should still show the robot miniature.
On a phone or a laptop: press Take all stories, wait for All stories on this device, then go offline and open the robot gang and one other story.
Install the app on the Quest, wait a few minutes online, then open it offline: every story should start, narration included.
untested: Taking all stories in Quest Browser (its storage room and whether it keeps them), and how long it runs on a headset.
The robot gang from its package in a real headset session and a shared room of several headsets.
